environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed on EC2 instance in public subnet with an Application Load Balancer (internet-facing). ALB forwards all headers including X-Forwarded-Host and X-Cache-Variant to the backend. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF rules attached. Route53 public hosted zone resolves to ALB DNS.

config.dns: public Route53 A-record alias to ALB
